summary: This dataset focuses on investigating the mechanisms underlying myopia development, with a specific objective to test the hypothesis that optical and neural anisotropy in the human peripheral visual system plays a crucial role in axial elongation. To achieve this, innovative optical tools, including a compact scanning ocular wavefront sensor and an open-view scanning adaptive optics vision simulator, will be developed and implemented. The dataset will involve characterizing how different aberration profiles impact retinal image quality and neural functions in school children, examining the relationships between changes in peripheral aberrations and myopia development.
